caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a grid design, divided into nine individual rectangular and square sections, each bordered by blue lines. Each section contains a unique floral or plant arrangement with green buds, stems, and leaves and mainly red, blue, and pink flowers, some of which are in baskets or pots. Several sections feature small birds or other animals. The quilt is surrounded by a wide outer border, decorated with a continuous green vine filled with stylized flowers, leaves, and small animals or birds arranged in a repeating pattern. The background of the quilt and border is a light, off-white or cream color. The overall palette includes shades of green, blue, red, pink, and yellow, with the blue lines serving as boundaries between the sections.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
